title: Turmeric (Haridra) — traditional use for wound healing
source_reference: General, widely-corroborated Ayurvedic/ethnobotanical knowledge — NOT a specific chapter/verse citation. Exact classical-text citation (e.g. a specific Charaka Samhita or Sushruta Samhita reference) must be sourced from the CCRAS e-Samhita/APTA Digital Library per ai/prompts/phases.md T1.1 before this record is treated as citation-grade.
traditional_use: Turmeric (known as Haridra in Ayurveda) has a long, widely documented history of traditional use in India for wound healing and skin conditions. This general fact is well corroborated and is the traditional-knowledge basis that defeated the US turmeric wound-healing patent (see ipr_prior_art record ipr_seed_000001) — link these two records in the knowledge graph (Phase 5, T5.4) as a worked example of TK-as-prior-art.
traditional_knowledge_category: classical/generic (general traditional use; specific formulation not sourced here)
patent_relevance: Directly relevant — documented traditional use of this kind is exactly what Section 3(p) is designed to exclude from patentability, and is the basis on which the real US patent 5,401,504 was revoked.
data_quality_note: The general fact of traditional turmeric use for wound healing is safe and well corroborated. Deliberately left ingredients/quantities/preparation_method/chapter/page as null rather than inventing plausible-sounding classical-text specifics — do not fill these in without a verified source.

title: Neem (Nimba) — traditional use as antimicrobial and pest-repellent
source_reference: General, widely-corroborated Ayurvedic/ethnobotanical and agricultural knowledge — NOT a specific chapter/verse citation. See note on tk_seed_000001; the same sourcing requirement applies here.
traditional_use: Neem (Nimba) has a long, widely documented history of traditional use in India both medicinally (skin conditions, antimicrobial applications) and agriculturally (natural pesticide/fungicide). This general fact is well corroborated and is the traditional-knowledge basis that defeated the EPO neem fungicide patent (see ipr_prior_art record ipr_seed_000002).
traditional_knowledge_category: classical/generic (general traditional use; specific formulation not sourced here)
patent_relevance: Directly relevant — the basis on which EP 0436257 was revoked by the EPO on biopiracy/lack-of-inventive-step grounds.
data_quality_note: Same caveats as tk_seed_000001 — general fact is safe, specifics are deliberately left unsourced rather than fabricated.
